question.text: GST on a derivative trade is charged at:

answer.text: 18% on the sum of brokerage and transaction charges
No GST is applicable on brokerage

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series VIII workbook (page 141), GST is charged at 18 per cent on brokerage plus transaction charges. The workbook's cost example applies GST to brokerage and the various transaction charges levied on the trade. The Trap: GST is not charged on the full contract value, is not 12% or 5%, and is applied to brokerage plus transaction charges rather than brokerage alone. Note: Source: NISM Series VIII workbook, page 141.
